h1: Demolition in the Bemidji & Leech Lake Area
metaTitle: Demolition Contractor in Bemidji, MN | Shepard
metaDesc: Cabin teardowns, garages, and small commercial demolition, hauled away clean, across the Bemidji and Leech Lake area. Call Shepard at (218) 224-2754.
lead: Old cabins, garages, sheds, and small commercial structures, torn down and hauled away clean. We bring the equipment and the dumpsters, so it is all one call.
included: Debris haul-off with our own roll-off dumpsters
factors: Size and type of the structure
Whether there is concrete or a foundation to remove
timeline: Most residential teardowns are a few days, including cleanup and haul-off.
expect: We knock it down, load it out, and grade the spot back so you would hardly know it was there. Roll-off dumpsters and hauling are part of what we do, so you are not chasing down a separate company.

faqs.q: Do you tear down cabins and garages?
faqs.a: Yes. Cabin teardowns, old garages, sheds, and small commercial buildings are regular work for us.

faqs.q: Can you remove an old foundation?
faqs.a: Yes. We remove concrete slabs and block foundations and bring in fill to grade the site back. Have a look at the before and after on our homepage.
We do, with our own roll-off dumpsters and trucks. One call covers the teardown and the cleanup.
Some demolition needs a permit. We will let you know what your job requires and help you sort it out.
